data.name: Cogwork Sentinel
data.subtitle: Automated Guardian
data.description: A hulking automaton of brass and iron, originally designed to guard the great workshops of Rifts and Rivets. Many have gone haywire over the centuries, their directive protocols corrupted into attacking anything that moves. Steam hisses from their joints and their single optical lens glows an angry red.
data.tacticsDescription: Cogwork Sentinels are slow but relentless. They march directly toward the nearest target and attempt to smash it. When surrounded, they vent superheated steam in all directions.

abilities.name: Armored Plating
abilities.description: Reduce all physical damage taken by 2. Does not apply to electrical or acid damage.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.description: The Sentinel's next Pneumatic Fist attack deals an additional D6 damage, but the Sentinel takes 2 damage from internal stress.

data.extraInfo: Cogwork Sentinels were originally manufactured by the Ironwright Guild during the Second Mechanical Age to protect high-value workshops and vaults. Their directive cores run on punch-card logic systems that have degraded over centuries of neglect. A skilled engineer can sometimes reprogram a Sentinel by accessing the maintenance panel on its back (DC 18 Intelligence (Engineering) check), converting it into a temporary ally for up to one hour. The Sentinel Core salvaged from these constructs can be used to power small workshop equipment for months.

data.name: Spark Gremlin
data.subtitle: Mischievous Saboteur
data.description: A tiny, cackling creature no bigger than a housecat, with oversized ears and fingers that crackle with static electricity. Spark Gremlins infest workshops and power stations throughout Rifts and Rivets, delighting in sabotaging machinery and shocking the unwary. Individually weak, they become dangerous in swarms.
data.tacticsDescription: Spark Gremlins avoid direct combat, preferring to zap from hiding spots and flee. They target equipment and weapons first, trying to disable gear before targeting people. Always found in groups of 3-6.

abilities.name: Sabotage
abilities.description: Target one piece of mechanical equipment or weapon within short range. The item malfunctions and cannot be used for 1 round.

data.extraInfo: Spark Gremlins are thought to be minor fey creatures drawn to the concentrated magical-mechanical energy of Rifts and Rivets. They are not truly malicious — they simply find the destruction of complex machinery to be endlessly entertaining. Some tinkers have had success luring Spark Gremlins away with decoy devices: wind-up toys or sparking contraptions left as distractions. A captured Spark Gremlin can be convinced to charge small electrical devices in exchange for shiny objects, though they are notoriously unreliable partners.
